name: Brand24
summary: Social listening and media monitoring: tracks mentions of your brand, competitors and keywords across social media, news, blogs and Reddit, with AI sentiment analysis, AI insights on higher plans and reports for teams and agencies.
best_for: marketing and PR teams, agencies and growing businesses that want to track mentions of their brand, competitors and campaigns across social media, news, blogs and Reddit, with AI sentiment analysis
skip_if: you only need to check a few mentions now and then, where free alerts or manual searches cost nothing; or your budget is below $199 a month, since there is no free plan
honest_knock: There is no free plan, and the cheapest one, Individual at $199 a month billed annually, covers 3 keywords, 2K mentions and a single user with updates only every 12 hours. Teams start at $299. AI Insights and Topics begin on Pro at $399 billed annually, and API access costs an extra $149.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-18 in a browser on brand24.com/prices in the monthly and annual view, USD) Five plans, priced per month. Individual is $249 a month billed monthly or $199 a month billed annually: 3 keywords, 2K mentions a month, 1 user, updates every 12 hours. Team is $349 or $299: 7 keywords, 10k mentions, unlimited users, hourly updates and chat support. Pro is $499 or $399: 12 keywords, 40K mentions, real-time updates, AI Events Detection, the AI Brand Assistant, and AI Insights and AI Topics for 2 projects. Business is $699 or $599: 25 keywords, 100K mentions, AI Insights for 5 projects, a Client Success Lead and advanced reports. Enterprise starts at $1,499 a month billed annually, with custom keyword and mention limits and the AI Visibility module. API access is sold at an additional fee of $149; the page does not say for what period. The annual toggle advertises 'Up to 3 months free'. There is no free plan; the 14-day trial needs no credit card. The pricing FAQ offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, excluding custom plans and deals negotiated with the sales team, says you can cancel at any time, and says you are never charged more than your plan's price if you exceed its limits.

compare_with.name: Superlines
compare_with.why: Superlines is in our dossiers too, but it watches a different place: how AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity mention and cite your brand, from 79 € a month for 50 tracked prompts when we read it on 16 October 2026. Brand24 tracks what people publish about you on social media, news sites, blogs and Reddit, from $199 a month billed annually, and lists an AI Visibility module only on its Enterprise plan. If answer-engine visibility is the question, the specialist is cheaper; for social and press mentions, Brand24 is the tool.
